snippet.title: Tornado gameplay (PC Game, 1993)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Tornado, Dos PC game produced by Digital Integration in 1993 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/tornado/1567/
Exploring the interface and flying around in this combat flight sim.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
